algorithm.camera_total: float64 sum of canonical float32 per-frame degrees over each 12-frame block, axis order yaw,pitch
algorithm.class: -1 if total < -threshold; +1 if total > threshold; else 0
algorithm.keyboard: modal exact packed 23-bit state over 12 frames; smallest uint32 wins count ties
algorithm.representative: per axis/class median absolute train total; neutral is zero; distributed uniformly over 12 canonical camera frames
algorithm.threshold: per axis numpy.quantile(abs(nonzero train block totals), 0.5, method=linear)
